3. An extra copy of the brief be served on the learned counsel for the State to enable him to intimate the informant/victim that the matter shall be taken up on 01.05.2025 and another copy be also filed in the Registry within three working days.
4.

Registry is called upon to send the extra copy of the brief received from the learned counsel for the Petitioner to the learned Court in seisin who is requested to contact the informant/victim and apprise that it shall be open to them to participate in the proceeding and put-forth their stand.
If they are not in a position to engage any counsel, they can seek legal aid through the aegis of the Legal Services Authority.
5. Registry is requested to do the needful.
Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with T.R. Case No.62 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge Court, Special Judge under POCSO Act, Nabarangpur,
arising out of Tentulikhunti P.S. Case No.147 of 2022 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363/366/342/109/376(2)(n)/313 of IPC read with Section 17 & 6 of POCSO Act.
3. An extra copy of the brief be served on the learned counsel for the State to enable him to intimate the informant/victim that the matter shall be taken up on 01.05.2025 and another copy be also filed in the Registry within three working days.
4.
If they are not in a position to engage any counsel, they can seek legal aid through the aegis of the Legal Services Authority.
6. List this matter on 01.05.2025.
7. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
8. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
